title: Enquiries
headline: A conversation begins with a question.
intro: Technical enquiries about Alchemy, research collaborations and service architecture are welcome.
summary: This edition does not claim a verified public mailbox or live form endpoint. Contact delivery will be activated through the owned SMTP/IMAP and identity stack after independent acceptance.

sections.heading: An intentional communications boundary
sections.body: Rasen Falcon is being developed as a public home and operational dogfood environment for Alchemy. An active contact channel requires its own verified DNS, authenticated mail handling, abuse controls and recipient routing.
points: A real inbox, not a decorative form
No collection of personal data without a receiver

sections.heading: What to include later
sections.body: Project context, required capabilities and the best way to make contact will be enough for a technical enquiry. Never send passwords, credentials or personal secrets via an unverified channel.
